name: Fence Job Margin

products.name: Fence Job Margin
products.product: Prices fence jobs from footage, terrain, demolition, gates, post method, material waste, travel, and crew production.
products.problem: Per-foot pricing misses site conditions and material volatility, producing avoidable margin losses.
products.valueProposition: Calculates a transparent quote floor and compares estimated production with completed-job results.
products.startupCost: Solo MVP: web app, CSV import, managed database, and optional read-only integrations.
products.seoAngle: Targets purchase and problem-aware searches including: fence estimating software; fence job cost calculator; fence contractor bidding software; fence estimating and job costing software; fence estimating and job costing calculator; fence estimating and job costing pricing
products.seoThesis: A narrow site for residential and light-commercial fence installers can connect commercial pages, calculators, comparisons, and implementation guides around fence estimating and job costing to the same measurable margin outcome.
searchQueries: fence estimating and job costing software
fence estimating and job costing calculator
fence estimating and job costing pricing
products.profitRationale: Search intent is explicit, quotes recur, and a focused estimator can monetize before deeper integrations exist.
products.primaryRisk: Many basic calculators are free, so differentiation requires actual-cost learning and operational depth.
